clips.title: The story
paras: Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Ban'ethil Barrow Den beneath Teldrassil's roots. The sacred chambers were made for the sleeping Druids of the Talon, whose spirits commune with the Emerald Dream. Now the den is a dangerous warren, and the druids within are at risk.

Ban'ethil Barrow Den lies beneath Teldrassil's roots, with upper and lower chambers. Barrow dens shelter night elf druids as they sleep and send their spirits into the Emerald Dream. This den was made for the Druids of the Talon to commune with nature. Its halls once held quiet meditation, but the corruption spreading through Teldrassil's wildlife reached the Gnarlpine furbolgs. They invaded the den and made its hollowed chambers a fortified warren.

The Gnarlpine tribe has gone mad under a mysterious corruption spreading across the World Tree. Its furbolgs drove out or endangered the sleeping druids, and now guard the winding tunnels fiercely, attacking any night elf who approaches. Teldrassil's defenders must drive them back to protect the vulnerable druids and the sacred relics trapped in the den's lower depths.
